inputs.text: A single enemy character render for a dark fantasy action RPG: a shambling undead human, the classic zombie of a haunted ruin, seen from a slightly elevated three-quarter angle, full body, centered on a flat solid pure chroma magenta #ff00ff background filling the whole frame, no floor, no contact shadow, no gradient, no vignette, no scenery. Slumped heavy posture, belly forward, arms hanging and reaching loose, one leg dragging: a slow, heavy silhouette, not an athletic one. Rotten grey-green ashy flesh with sunken hollow cheeks and open dark wounds and visible pale bone showing through torn skin (bone #C6BDAA), milky blind eyes, clumps of grey hair. Tattered rotted burial clothes and a few rusted iron plates still buckled on the ribs, muted brown #594536 cloth rags, dark blood burgundy #642A32 stains, dull aged iron. Dark Gothic Fantasy, realistic stylization, painterly detail, believable decayed materials and subtle cold rim lighting. No text, no watermark.
